decisive_items: Gram stain and cultures were negative
response.rationale: Atypical squamous cells with progressive enlargement and sterile purulence favor squamous cell carcinoma over simple abscess; the explicit absence of a tract to the anal canal rules out anorectal fistula.

rejected.why: Recurrent sterile abscess with atypical cytology is atypical for a simple abscess and more consistent with malignancy.
No fistula to the anal canal was found; the external sinus tract likely resulted from tumor erosion.
